onboarding.welcomeSubtitle: Let's set up your income sources, pay date, and category allocations.
onboarding.step1Desc: Your Monthly Period will start on this date each month. If a month does not have this date (e.g. 31st in February), it adjusts automatically to the last day.
onboarding.payDayInputHelp: Enter a number between 1 and 31 according to your main income or salary cycle.
onboarding.step2Title: Where Does Your Income Come From?
onboarding.step2Desc: Add one or more regular monthly income sources (salary, commissions, freelance, business). This total forms the Monthly Income for your budget allocation.
onboarding.totalIncomeHelp: This total will be allocated into your monthly budget categories in the next step.
onboarding.step3Desc: Pick a starting point for your budget division. You can customize category names, percentages, or add/remove categories in the next step.
onboarding.step4Desc: Set names, percentage allocations, and mark savings categories. Total percentages must equal exactly 100%.
onboarding.allocationExact: ✓ Total percentage is exactly 100%. You're ready to use Takerin!
onboarding.allocationOver: Over by {{percent}}%. Total allocation cannot exceed 100%.
onboarding.minOneSource: Must have at least one income source.
onboarding.minOneCategory: Must have at least one category.
onboarding.tpl503020Desc: Classic split: 50% Needs, 30% Wants, 20% Savings & Investment.
onboarding.tpl6ToplesDesc: T. Harv Eker method: Needs (55%), Long-term Savings (10%), Investments (10%), Education (10%), Entertainment (10%), Donation (5%).
onboarding.tplCustomDesc: Define your own category names and percentages based on your financial lifestyle.

tutorial.slide1Desc: This is your dashboard — see category balances here
tutorial.slide2Desc: Press the + button to record expenses — in just 5 seconds!
tutorial.slide3Desc: At the end of every month, check summaries and AI tips in History
tutorial.slide4Desc: Congratulations! Start allocating your income now 🎉

mockup.aiQuote: "Awesome! Your living needs expense is neatly controlled at 49%. Your savings allocation is fully achieved this month! 🎉"

form.exceededWarning: Amount exceeds remaining balance for this category.

expenses.warningOverBudgetDesc: Amount {{amount}} exceeds category balance ({{balance}}). Expense can still be saved, but this category balance will be negative (over-budget).

categories.title: Category Management
categories.subtitle: Manage allocation percentages for your budget and freeze categories if needed
categories.freezeTooltip: Frozen categories cannot receive new expense records
categories.deleteConfirmDesc: This category will be deleted from the active period. Ensure allocations are adjusted back to 100%.
categories.allocationRuleWarning: Total allocation percentage across all active categories must sum to 100%.
categories.frozenSectionDesc: This category was disabled mid-period. Category balance remains recorded but cannot receive new expenses.
categories.validationExact100: Total percentage must be exactly 100% to save (currently {{total}}%).
categories.validationEmptyNames: All category names must be filled and cannot be empty.
categories.validationReady: ✓ Allocation configuration is valid and ready to save.
categories.addModalDesc: Other category percentages must be reduced so total allocation remains 100%.
categories.freezeModalDesc: Category "{{name}}" has an allocation of {{percentage}}%. This category will be frozen so it cannot receive new expenses. Transfer this {{percentage}}% allocation to other active categories:
categories.addErrorPercentRange: Category percentage must be between 1% and 99%.
categories.addErrorPercentTooLarge: Percentage too large for the new category.
categories.addErrorReductionMismatch: Total reduction ({{reduced}}%) must exactly match the new category percentage ({{newPercent}}%).
categories.addErrorCategoryExceeded: Category reduction for "{{name}}" exceeds remaining allocation. Percentage must remain above 0%.
categories.freezeErrorRedistributionMismatch: Total redistribution ({{added}}%) must exactly match the frozen category percentage ({{targetPercent}}%).
categories.minOneActiveCategory: Must have at least one active category.
